author: Irui Wang, MediaTek
subject: PATCH v6 2/6 media: mediatek: encoder: Add a new encoder driver interface
fact: The new interface places source and bitstream addresses in shared firmware parameters and delegates SPS, PPS and frame commands to vpu_enc_encode. It reads the encoded-byte count at0x98 after the IRQ wait.
inference: This examined modern public interface supplies no direct MT6797 source/reference/reconstruction/scratch/start/stop register contract. It cannot justify a firmware-free Gemini encoder backend.
